'''Secret recipes''' are recipes that never appear in the recipe book. Matcha Flavoured unlocks most recipes through hidden advancements when the player picks up an ingredient (see [[Cooking#Recipe unlocks|Cooking]]), but a few foods are left out on purpose, for the player to discover by experimenting or to learn from a [[Cooking Recipe]]. The developer mentions "a few secret foods" in the pack's introduction, and more secret recipes for tools, armor and shields.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=There are 12 ingredients with unique effects plus two more that act as secret ingredients, a few secret foods and four special meals}}</ref><ref>{{Cite video|quote=More secret recipes for food, tools, armor, and shields.}}</ref>

Because the pack doesn't limit crafting to known recipes, a secret recipe works as soon as its ingredients are placed in the right grid or station.

This page covers the secret food recipes, which the pack marks as secret through two advancements and the Cooking Recipes. The developer also mentions secret recipes for tools, armor and shields, but the pack's files don't mark any, so which ones are meant isn't known.

{{Spoiler}}

== Secret ingredients ==
Four ingredients have simple preparations whose recipes are never unlocked. Getting any of them into the inventory, usually by cooking it, grants the advancement ''Hidden Flavors'' (1 [[obol]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_secret_food.json}}</ref>

|-
| {{ItemLink|Warped Fungus}} || {{ItemLink|Braised Warped Fungus}} || {{EffectLink|Invisibility}}
|-

Picking up crimson or warped fungus only unlocks the red and cyan dye recipes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/crimson_fungus.json}}</ref>

=== Cooking Recipes ===
{{Main|Cooking Recipe}}
Four dishes are taught by a '''Cooking Recipe''', a paper item that unlocks its recipe as soon as it enters the inventory:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/cooking_recipes/gnocchi_recipe.json}}</ref>
* [[Gnocchi]]: found in [[mineshaft]] chests.
* [[Sweet Berry Toast]]: sold by a Novice [[Cook]] for 1 obol.
* [[Warped Stroganoff]]: sold by an Apprentice Cook for 1 obol.
* [[Chorus Mochi]]: sold by a Journeyman Cook for 1 obol.
The Cook also sells the finished sweet berry toast, warped stroganoff and chorus mochi.

== Other recipes without an unlock ==
These recipes also never enter the recipe book, although they are not listed among the secret foods:
* [[Popped Chorus Fruit|Popped chorus fruit]]: the chorus fruit unlock advancement grants a recipe ID that doesn't exist (<code>food/oven/popped_chorus_fruit</code>), while the recipe is stored as <code>food/crafting/popped_chorus_fruit</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/chorus_fruit.json}}</ref>
* [[Pupusa]]: no advancement unlocks it.
* [[Dried Kelp|Dried kelp]] (oven), [[Fried Egg|fried egg]]s and cooked meat and fish: cooked like their vanilla counterparts, with no unlock.
* Every kindling recipe, which doesn't need one.
* The legacy [[ramen]], a crafting recipe left over from an earlier version.
